Cave Entrance.description: The mouth of a vast cave system yawns before you. Cool air carries the scent of damp stone and ancient dust.
Cave Entrance.static_description: You stand at the mouth of a vast cave system. Cool, damp air carries the scent of ancient stone and forgotten ages. A faint glow from bioluminescent fungi paints the walls in shades of ghostly blue.

Rocky Path.description: A winding path of jagged stones leads deeper into the darkness. The ceiling drips with moisture.
Rocky Path.static_description: Jagged stones pave a winding path deeper into the earth. Moisture drips from the ceiling, creating tiny echoes that dance through the darkness. The air grows cooler as you descend.

Narrow Passage.description: The walls close in around you. You must turn sideways to squeeze through in places.
Narrow Passage.static_description: The passage narrows drastically here, forcing you to turn sideways and press through tight gaps. The rough stone scrapes against your shoulders. Up ahead, the tunnel widens again.

Goblin Cavern.description: A large cavern littered with bones and crude tools. The stench of goblin is unmistakable.
Goblin Cavern.static_description: This sprawling cavern bears all the marks of goblin habitation: scattered bones, crude wooden tools, and a wretched stench that clings to the air. Flickering shadows suggest movement in the periphery.

Treasure Chamber.description: Gold and jewels spill from shattered chests. A single golden idol sits upon a stone pedestal.
Treasure Chamber.static_description: Sunlight has never touched this place, yet the room glitters with reflected torchlight. Gold coins, cut jewels, and ancient artifacts lie heaped against the walls. At the center, a stone pedestal holds a single golden idol, its empty eyes staring into eternity.

Ancient Vault.description: An ancient stone vault sealed for centuries. The air is dry and still.
Ancient Vault.static_description: The massive stone door grooms open to reveal a vault sealed for centuries. Dust hangs thick in the still air. Shelves line the walls, holding relics of a civilization long turned to dust. A legendary blade rests on a central altar.

Crossroads.description: Four passages converge here. Faint whispers echo from each direction.
Crossroads.static_description: Four tunnels meet at this natural junction, each one promising different fates. Faint, indistinguishable whispers seem to emanate from the very stone. A carved signpost, weathered by centuries, stands at the center with indecipherable symbols.

Forgotten Armory.description: Racks of rusted weapons line the walls. A few pieces remain in good condition.
Forgotten Armory.static_description: This chamber was once an armory, its walls lined with weapon racks that have long since crumbled. Most of the arms have rusted to uselessness, but a shield and iron helm among the debris still gleam with a faint oil sheen.

Underground Lake.description: An underground lake stretches into darkness. The water is perfectly still and impossibly clear.
Underground Lake.static_description: A vast underground lake spreads before you, its surface like black glass reflecting the bioluminescent fungi on the ceiling. The water is so clear you can see the stone floor far below. At the water's edge, half-buried in silt, a sword glints.

Rat Tunnels.description: Low-ceilinged tunnels that smell of fur and filth. Scurrying sounds surround you.
Rat Tunnels.static_description: These tunnels were carved by water—and something else. The ceiling is low, forcing you to stoop. The stench of wet fur and guano is overwhelming. Red eyes gleam from the darkness as giant rats scatter.

Ancient Library.description: Towering shelves of petrified books line the walls. Knowledge turns to dust at your touch.
Ancient Library.static_description: This grand library has survived the centuries, though barely. Towering shelves, bowed under the weight of countless books, line every wall. The tomes crumble at a touch, but a few scrolls on a central table remain intact, preserved by some ancient magic.

Meditation Chamber.description: A circular chamber with a smooth stone floor. The acoustics are perfect—every sound rings clear.
Meditation Chamber.static_description: A perfectly circular chamber with a floor worn smooth by countless feet. The acoustics here are remarkable—your heartbeat echoes off the walls in rhythmic waves. A single stone basin in the center still holds clear water.

Hidden Passage.description: A secret passage hidden behind a false bookshelf. Dust motes dance in the torchlight.
Hidden Passage.static_description: The bookshelf swings open silently on well-oiled hinges, revealing a narrow passage beyond. Dust motes dance in your torchlight like floating stars. The walls are lined with faded frescoes depicting a great battle between light and shadow.

Dragon's Lair.description: The heat is intense. A massive form stirs in the shadows, scales gleaming like molten metal.
Dragon's Lair.static_description: The heat hits you like a physical force. This vast chamber is the lair of an elder wyrm—its scales smolder with inner fire, casting dancing shadows across walls covered in molten gold veins. The beast's eye, the size of your fist, slowly opens.

Healing Spring.description: A grotto with a crystal-clear pool at its center. Warm steam rises from the water, carrying a mineral scent.
Healing Spring.static_description: You enter a peaceful grotto where a natural spring bubbles up from deep within the earth. The water is warm and luminous, casting dancing reflections on the stone ceiling. A greater health potion rests on a rock beside the pool. The air feels restorative here.

Verdant Cavern.description: This cavern is filled with strange phosphorescent plants that pulse with soft blue light.
Verdant Cavern.static_description: Unlike the rest of the cave system, this chamber teems with life. Glowing fungi in shades of blue and violet carpet the floor and walls. Strange flowers with silver veins bloom in the dim light. The air is thick with the scent of damp earth and sweet nectar.

Collapsed Tunnel.description: The ceiling has partially collapsed here, creating a maze of rubble and broken pillars.
Collapsed Tunnel.static_description: An ancient collapse has transformed this passage into a treacherous maze of broken stone and twisted iron supports. Dust still hangs in the air. Among the rubble, you spot the glint of something metallic — a health potion wedged between two fallen pillars.

Echoing Hall.description: A grand hall with a vaulted ceiling. Every sound echoes impossibly, as if the room itself is alive.
Echoing Hall.static_description: You stand in a vast natural hall with a ceiling that soars into darkness above. The acoustics are extraordinary — your footsteps reverberate like drumbeats, and whispers seem to answer from the shadows. Ancient murals cover the walls, depicting a ritual of some kind.

Escape Tunnel.description: A rough-hewn tunnel sloping upward. Fresh air—you can smell it!
Escape Tunnel.static_description: This tunnel slopes steeply upward, its walls rough and uneven as if carved in desperate haste. But it's the air that stops you—fresh, clean air carrying the scent of pine and earth. Freedom is near.

Sunlit Valley.description: You emerge into a sun-drenched valley. The world stretches before you. You have escaped the darkness.
Sunlit Valley.static_description: You shield your eyes as brilliant sunlight floods your vision. Green grass, towering pines, and a clear blue sky stretch before you. Birds sing. A gentle breeze carries the scent of wildflowers. The darkness of the caves feels like a distant nightmare. You are free.
